conflicts.annotation: The proposal states the OP3.3 target as 85 (interpreted as 85%) while the AR1 logframe export records 0.75 (a proportion, equivalent to 75%). These differ in both numeric representation (percentage vs proportion) and in the underlying target value (85% vs 75%). Although these also span different periods (full-programme vs AR1 milestone), the unit/scale inconsistency is flagged here for Gate-1 review. Reviewers should confirm: (a) whether the logframe has adopted a different scale convention, and (b) whether the AR1 milestone target of 75% is intentionally lower than the full-programme target of 85%, or whether a data entry error has occurred.
